title: Discovering Our World Through English
summary: Students will explore basic cultural differences and similarities in English-speaking countries, focusing on daily routines, food, and traditions, to develop an initial sense of intercultural awareness.
subject: FOREIGN_LANGUAGE_ENGLISH
assessment_criteria: The student can identify simple cultural elements in English.
The student can compare their own culture with another using basic vocabulary.

activities.title: How do we say hello?
activities.instructions: Listen to the audio clip of a greeting in English. Choose the correct Spanish translation.

content.prompt: What is the meaning of 'Hello' in Spanish?
content.explanation: 'Hello' is used to greet someone, which translates to 'Hola' in Spanish. 'Adiós' means goodbye and 'Por favor' means please.

activities.title: What do they eat?
activities.instructions: Look at the picture of the food. Select the correct English word for the item shown.

content.prompt: Which word matches the picture of a round, yellow fruit?
content.explanation: An orange is a round, orange-colored fruit. An apple is usually red or green, and a banana is long and curved.

activities.title: Traditions around the world
activities.instructions: Read the description of the celebration. Drag the item to the correct category: 'My Country' or 'English Country'.

content.prompt: Sort these celebrations based on where they are traditionally celebrated.
content.explanation: Christmas and Halloween are common in English-speaking countries, while Semana Santa and Día de la Constitución are celebrated in Spain.
